name: Mononeko
source:
Despite the fact I'm sure I could definitely beat half these scum up I'm not trusted to be in the Prison myself for safety reasons. For that reason they've applied a Robotic Warden to monitor and interact with the prisoners directly.

I'm not really sure how we got Mononeko, I swear we just sort of found it in a dumpster. Oh well, not my issue. They seem to be doing their job, so we obviously recoded them correctly. They've even got a bit of a personality, which I like.

They apparently did 'glitch out and bite some of the production members but but that's that's really not, my issue. The health and safety of those Ultimates don't really matter to me.

[From the [url=https://danganronpa-fanganprojects.fandom.com/wiki/Mononeko_(Danganronpa_Antebellum:_LOCKDOWN)]Wiki[/url]]
